You lift your weapon and feel a second, burning edge reach out from its tip.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute

One visible creature within 3 squares.

Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Attack

Extend a blade of fire from your held melee weapon. This card supplies its reach; other melee attacks keep their own range.

Weak
4 fire damage.
Standard
4 fire damage and push 2 squares.
Strong
6 fire damage, push 2 squares and Burning 2.
